preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
The length of the string s must be between 1 and 5000.
The total length of all strings s across all test cases must not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the lexicographically smallest string s_prime followed by the chosen value of k.

postconditions.expression: all(s_prime <= s for s in modified_strings)
postconditions.description: The output string s_prime must be lexicographically smaller than or equal to all possible modified strings.
The chosen value of k must be the smallest among all k values that produce the lexicographically smallest string.
